title: surf2vol
description: Diffuse surface deformation to volumes using surface and MRI data.

fixed_surface.description: File path for the main fixed surface.
fixed_surface.title: Fixed Surface

moving_surface.description: File path for the main moving surface.
moving_surface.title: Moving Surface

output_file.description: Output file for the result, default is out.mgz.
output_file.title: Output File

output_field.description: Output field file, default is out_field.mgz.
output_field.title: Output Field

output_affine.description: Path for the output affine file.
output_affine.title: Output Affine

output_surf.description: Root file name for output surfaces which will have indices appended for each surface.
output_surf.title: Output Surface

output_surf_affine.description: Root file name for output surfaces with affine transformations.
output_surf_affine.title: Output Surface Affine

output_mesh.description: File path for the output mesh.
output_mesh.title: Output Mesh

spacing_x.description: Specifies the x spacing for the deformation grid.
spacing_x.title: Spacing X

spacing_y.description: Specifies the y spacing for the deformation grid.
spacing_y.title: Spacing Y

spacing_z.description: Specifies the z spacing for the deformation grid.
spacing_z.title: Spacing Z

poisson_ratio.description: Poisson ratio for material properties, default is 0.3.
poisson_ratio.title: Poisson Ratio

dirty_factor.description: Factor for dirty regions, between 0 and 1.
dirty_factor.title: Dirty Factor

debug_output.description: Enable debug output, writing a morph file at each iteration.
debug_output.title: Debug Output

cache_transform.description: Path to save transformation cache for reusing in subsequent runs.
cache_transform.title: Cache Transform
